description: Get detailed information about a specific Protect user.

fields.name: ucoreUserId
fields.description: The unique id of the UniFi Identity user. Matches the id field of the corresponding UlpUser.

fields.name: modelKey
fields.description: The model key of the user

local.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/users/{id}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Get user details
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/users/{id}"
    method: GET
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
